claims: "He discusses Rashi's explanations regarding... the reasons for sending three angels" - The teacher discusses the reason for the angels' visit (to heal Avraham and visit the sick), but he does not discuss why there were specifically three angels beyond quoting Rashi that each angel has one task.

"He discusses Rashi's explanations regarding... the details of offering food and water to the travelers." - The teacher discusses the offering of water and bread, but he does not discuss the details of the food preparation beyond mentioning the flour and the dough covering the pot.
summary: Rabbi Soffer goes through Rashi's commentary on the beginning of Parashat Vayera, examining the verses describing Hashem's visit to Avraham Avinu after his brit milah and the arrival of the guests. He discusses Rashi's explanations regarding Avraham sitting at the tent opening, the reasons for sending three angels, and the details of offering food and water to the travelers.
questions: Why did Hashem appear to Avraham Avinu on the third day after his brit milah?
Why was Avraham sitting at the opening of his tent during the heat of the day?
Why did three angels visit Avraham instead of just one?
What is the difference between kemach and solet in Rashi's commentary?
